test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a code language, ‘GOOD’ is written as ‘HMPB’, and ‘HALL’ is written as ‘IYMJ’. How will ‘TOOL’ be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

For, ‘GOOD’ is coded as ‘HMPB’, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/756c3122ec6cedb63ea31bf4598ca16b38c307a85acf56af754fa0b3a5d022b1.png] 

For, ‘HALL’ is coded as ‘IYMJ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/583997e3189556f964871cd3179255cbe0a971ebc3b69487615fec8fc47ccc5f.png] 

Similarly **‘TOOL’ will be coded as 'UMPJ'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/825d700e0b7fb7cafafb47fac35265c1ecf02d6427c6e8efce9511d423d6292b.png] 

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
